data.rationale: The proposal matches the true flow (Flights tab, trip type, origin/destination, date, passengers/Done, Search, Fastest, See flight, Select, Next) with parameters named for each varying input, but it adds a direct-only filter and a Flexible ticket choice the true actions don't clearly show, and it makes the filters vaguer.
